The removal of test cases for `QueryBuilderBWCIT` in `muted-tests.yml` is concerning. These tests are linked to specific issues (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/116990 and https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/116989) and their removal without proper resolution or documentation could lead to regressions.
In `QueryBuilderBWCIT.java`, the addition of new imports and logic in methods like `testQueryBuilderBWC` is necessary for handling transport versions correctly. However, the comment `// won't need to read <8.8 data anymore` suggests that this code might become obsolete if the legacy version handling is no longer required. It would be beneficial to have a clear plan or issue tracking the removal of this logic when it becomes unnecessary.
